title: Beyond Alignment: Value Diversity as a Collective Property in Multicultural Agent Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating how large language model-based agents represent diverse cultural values by comparing their responses to the World Values Survey (WVS) against human ground-truth data from 19 different cultures.

Measuring and comparing value alignment and system-level diversity across agents assigned specific national identities (e.g., Brazil, China, Mexico, Nigeria, New Zealand) to detect homogenization tendencies.
